sloka: नत्यूह कोयष्टि भकैर् नृत्यमानैश् च बर्हिभिः ।रुतम् पर भृतानाम् च शुश्रुवे वन निर्झरे ।। ६-३९-९।।
transliteration: natyūha koyaṣṭi bhakair nṛtyamānaiś ca barhibhiḥ ।rutam para bhṛtānām ca śuśruve vana nirjhare ।। 6-39-9।।

translations.english: The Vanaras heard the singing of cuckoos, dancing of peacocks, crying of gallinules, lapwings and herons from the gardens abounding in cascades.
